description: This PHP source file defines the TimesheetModel class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin API. The class implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits for serialization. It encapsulates a Timesheet entity, setting entity data, filters, and attribute names for API responses related to timesheet data, including id, status, startDate, and endDate.
